exposure: VTE risk group (low vs. high according to RCOG guidelines' score)
cohort: 100 pregnant women beyond 28 weeks of gestation, categorized into low-risk (<=2 points) and high-risk (>=3 points) VTE groups based on RCOG guidelines.
finding: The soluble fibrin monomer complex and D-dimer tests showed no significant difference between low-risk and high-risk VTE groups determined before delivery according to RCOG guidelines.
cross-section timing: Before delivery, among pregnant women beyond 28 weeks of gestation.
